method_note: Subjective editorial inquiry order, not a verified quality rating. Four criteria use point-in-time official license records, company claims and limited review accounts; 1–5 scores and weights are judgment. No provider was contacted. There is no comparable, attributed, current combined quote, so price is excluded from all scores.

weights.criterion: License evidence for a one-contract plumbing/building path
weights.basis: Editorial proxy: 5 for a checked B + C-36 combination; 2 for a C-36 plumbing lead without B; 1 for a restoration-only partner. B-only may also prime an appropriately structured job with a licensed plumbing subcontractor. No class proves acceptance, restoration skill, legal compliance or insurance.

weights.criterion: Evidence adjacent to the stuck-lever and access scope
weights.basis: Subjective 1–5, favoring a directly retrieved company case on ceiling-access overflow replacement over a blocked/search-index review or generic service. Third-party accounts are not adjudicated; absence of published evidence is not inability.

Subjective 1–5 using active status, issue/reissue dates, workers-comp entry and disclosed historical citations. These are not a quality guarantee; CSLB limits disclosure and does not verify classification-code accuracy.

weights.criterion: Evidence relevant to residential and occupied work
weights.basis: Subjective 1–5 based on company property-management/residential statements and limited review accounts; not a verified current protocol. Low means limited evidence found, not that a company cannot do the job.

ranked.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: B + C-36 and the company’s published property-manager work make it the strongest initial combined-scope inquiry. The 2003 issue date was followed by reissue to another entity in 2007. An old Angi bathtub-faucet account is positive; another reports an invoice/billing concern. Neither establishes this exact job or ceiling finish.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote. Request one fixed combined price; the owner reports are not Ace prices.
ranked.ask: Ask for the named ceiling finisher, safety plan, permitted access alternatives, itemized fixed price and warranty.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 and advertised property-manager work; verify the ceiling party and current price

ranked.name: Heise’s Plumbing
ranked.legal_name: TARO GROUP INC · dba HEISES PLUMBING
ranked.why: A directly retrieved company case describes accessing an exterior ceiling to replace a tub waste-and-overflow. It is adjacent, self-published evidence with an embedded 404 template; restoration is not shown. Current website identifies TARO Group #1089561; a BBB profile uses expired #787733, so its complaint cannot be automatically assigned to the current entity.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote. The published case gives no price and does not establish ceiling restoration.
ranked.ask: Ask whether one contract can name an appropriately licensed ceiling-restoration party, and confirm which legal entity and license will contract.
ranked.short_why: closest directly retrieved ceiling-access overflow case; restoration and older-entity relationship remain unconfirmed

ranked.name: Rapid Flow Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: Active B + C-36 and a company repair-to-renovation offer are promising for one contract. A Yelp-indexed tub-plug account describes wall access and pipe cutting, but the underlying page was blocked. The 2024 license record certifies a workers-comp exemption; ask about all employees or subcontractors.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote; no evidence fixes this project’s restoration cost.
ranked.ask: Ask who opens and patches the ceiling, who carries insurance, and whether the written quote covers both paths.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36; related wall-access review is only an unverified index excerpt

ranked.name: Ayoob & Peery
ranked.why: B + C-36 with an active record, 1980 issue date and workers-comp policy on file. The company emphasizes commercial wet-side systems; no specific tub overflow work, residential acceptance or price was found.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote; do not infer small-job pricing from its commercial positioning.
ranked.ask: Ask first whether this small occupied-unit repair is accepted and who would handle ceiling finishing.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 and long-standing record; small-job acceptance unknown

ranked.name: We Do Construction
ranked.why: B + C-36 and a company-published one-contract design/build offer; public material emphasizes larger renovation scopes. CSLB records workers compensation, but its classification codes do not verify actual coverage of a particular subcontractor or activity.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote. Ask about small-job minimums rather than assuming them.
ranked.ask: Confirm the exact repair size, on-site trades, insured parties and combined price.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36, but willingness to accept a small fixture repair is unknown

ranked.name: Expert Plumbing Solutions
ranked.why: Active C-36 and a residential plumbing offer. The owner reported $614 for a similarly named business, but no quote document confirms this CSLB record as the issuer; the scope does not explicitly mention ceiling restoration.
ranked.cost_note: Possible same-name owner report: $614 for waste-and-overflow replacement, unverified and not assigned to this license.
ranked.ask: Confirm the issuing legal entity and obtain a current combined price naming the restoration party.
ranked.short_why: C-36; possible $614 quote-name match is not a verified identity

ranked.name: Save-On-Interior
ranked.why: B + C-36 record shares a phone and address with Bay Area Plumbing, but that does not prove common ownership, a quote relationship or that it will accept the work. CSLB lists historical cash-deposit letters and a workers-comp exemption.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote. The owner’s Bay Area report cannot be assigned to this entity.
ranked.ask: Identify the actual contracting entity and ceiling finisher; ask for current insurance and a written combined quote.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36; shared contact details do not establish a relationship

ranked.name: Bay Area Plumbing
ranked.why: Active C-36 and residential plumbing offer; the owner reported $550 for a similarly named business, but the CSLB match is unconfirmed and spout/diverter may be a different part. Shared contact details with Save-On-Interior do not establish ownership.
ranked.cost_note: Possible same-name owner report: $550 for lever/plug/spout, labor and materials; issuer and comparable scope unverified.
ranked.ask: Confirm the legal issuer, parts, access method and ceiling-restoration provision.
ranked.short_why: C-36; possible $550 quote-name match and scope are unverified

ranked.name: Discount Plumbing Rooter Services
ranked.why: Current C-36/A record in Burlingame; CSLB records workers-comp, liability and LLC bond information. The records are point-in-time disclosures, not confirmation of coverage for this job. No specific tub-overflow or ceiling-restoration evidence found.
ranked.ask: Confirm service location, actual policy scope, named finisher and combined written price.
ranked.short_why: C-36/A backup with no documented exact-job or restoration offer

ranked.name: Fast Response Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.legal_name: JOSEPH TINSLEY · dba FAST RESPONSE PLUMBING AND ROOTER
ranked.why: Active C-36 record and residential plumbing offer. The owner supplied the generic name “Fast Response” for an adjustment quote, but the match to this licensee is unconfirmed. The workers-comp policy on CSLB expires 2026-12-18; check the policy on the work date.
ranked.cost_note: Possible name match to $135 owner-reported adjustment; issuer not confirmed and scope differs from replacement.
ranked.ask: Verify the issuer and policy, then request an itemized price for both paths and a named restoration party.
ranked.short_why: C-36; generic $135 quote-name match is unconfirmed and adjustment-only

ranked.name: In & Out Plumbing and Construction
ranked.legal_name: IN & OUT PLUMBING AND CONSTRUCTION INC
ranked.why: Cautious inquiry only: B + C-36, company advertises bathroom reconstruction, and an identified HomeAdvisor profile contains a positive separate electrical/drywall account plus complaints about prices, diagnosis and leaks. CSLB discloses six citations dated 2017–2018, including a completed building-permit violation and completed trade/contract/down-payment entries. A second bathtub review’s match to #878184 is unconfirmed.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote; no ceiling-restoration amount is established.
ranked.ask: Review each historical citation and mixed review; ask for an explanation, references, the named ceiling party, insurance and an itemized two-path quote. Website also lists (650) 679-7982.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 with related drywall review, but six historical citations and mixed reviews warrant extra diligence

ranked.name: Atlas Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: C-36/A specialty lead with a company fixture-repair offer. A Yelp-indexed account expressly names Atlas and describes stuck bathtub-lever assemblies, but the business page was blocked. Direct Angi accounts include both praise for occupied-home care and a missed-follow-up complaint; the 2008 license reissue is noted.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote. No quote for a combined ceiling restoration is available.
ranked.ask: Ask whether they can safely attempt tub-side removal, arrange the ceiling finisher under one contract, and provide one written two-path price. CSLB phone is shown; website lists (415) 849-2346.
ranked.short_why: C-36 plumbing specialist; indexed stuck-lever account is promising but not directly verified

ranked.name: Discover Plumbing & Rooter
ranked.why: C-36/A plumbing backup with an active CSLB record and a residential SF service offer. No exact overflow case or ceiling-restoration acceptance was found. The company site and CSLB record list different phone numbers.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote. Request the same written scope as other candidates.
ranked.ask: Ask about below-ceiling coordination, insurance and written price; the website also lists (415) 689-3544.
ranked.short_why: residential C-36 plumbing backup; no exact-job or restoration proof

ranked.name: Plumbing 1 Builder's
ranked.why: Active B + C-36 in Hayward, a possible one-contract path. The license was reissued to another entity in 2021, and a similarly named website returned site-not-published; association, SF service and small-job acceptance are unconfirmed.
ranked.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote; do not assume any travel surcharge.
ranked.ask: Use the CSLB business phone to confirm the legal entity, service address, restoration trade and written price.
ranked.short_why: B + C-36 backup; website association and San Francisco acceptance unconfirmed

partner.name: Bernal Hill Drywall
partner.why: Active B + C-9 and advertised patching, texture and painting; no C-36. A possible restoration partner. A B general contractor may also be able to prime a qualifying multi-trade contract with an appropriately licensed plumbing subcontractor; confirm this job structure under §7057.
partner.cost_note: No attributed comparable quote for patch/texture/paint; opening size and finish are unknown.
partner.ask: Ask whether the company can coordinate a qualifying single contract with a licensed plumbing subcontractor, or act as named finisher; request a conditional patch/texture/paint price and schedule after required inspection.
partner.short_why: C-9 + B drywall specialist, paired with a plumbing lead

not_recommended.name: SF Building Group

not_recommended.name: 24/7 SF Handyman & Remodeling Service
not_recommended.reason: B-2 residential remodeling only; BPC §7057.5 has specific limits on plumbing-system installation, replacement and substantial alteration. Check scope and an appropriately licensed plumber; small-job acceptance is unconfirmed.

not_recommended.name: Advanced Plumbing and Drain
not_recommended.reason: C-36 only, and the CSLB record carries an additional status warning that the licence may be suspended at a future date for an unresolved final liability. Resolve that before any inquiry.

not_recommended.name: Kenneth Asire Plumbing

not_recommended.name: Portola Plumbing Services

price_policy: No candidate is awarded or deducted points for price. All candidate-specific comparable project prices are unconfirmed; the three owner-reported amounts and names are shown separately, without assuming the CSLB identity match.
